text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Tosen Jordan and I are preparing for the Osaka Hai, the first race of the Senior Spring Triple Crown.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Others find our training methods silly, but we do what needs to be done.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: On the day of the Osaka Hai, she provokes Gold Ship, declaring that she'll be the bigger dummy.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Gold Ship seems amused and answers with a laugh.
